The global convex minimum F_t((2t)^(1/3))=(3/2)(2t)^(1/3)-t is positive iff 0<t<3sqrt(3)/2, proving strict all-gain invariance. Only positive fixed y=1 has multiplier 1-2t, stable iff 0<t<1. Distinct prime two-cycle equations imply s²=2p(p+1), t²=2p³/(p+1), p=uv>1; last expression strictly increases p>1 from 1 to infinity, giving exactly one positive cycle for t>1. Two-step multiplier M=5-8p+8/(p+1) strictly decreases from +1 and crosses -1 at 4p²+p-7=0, p=(sqrt113-1)/8, t*=1.25819035934. Independently checked symbolic t² relation, multiplier algebra, and numerical threshold. Package symbolic program also checks explicit p=9/8 witness M=-4/17. The assertions classify only hyperbolic endpoints, not global basins or t=1,t=t* nonhyperbolic behavior.
